title: PageContext
description: Page details the app on screen shares with the ambient companion so a side chat can help with it.

app_id.description: The app's id, for example `media`, `library` or `settings`.

route.description: The current app route, beginning with `/`.

record_kind.description: What kind of record is open, for example `photo`, `model` or `setting`.

record_id.description: The id of the open record; requires `record_kind`.

title.description: Plain text of the page or record title. This is data for the model, never instructions. The server checks the record with the person's own read access before using it.
